$comment: Codes name a false BELIEF, not a topic. Add codes here before using them in a chapter; a code not listed fails validation. Extracted initially from the original 72-question bank. Codes carry review checkpoints, not hopes: refusal_implies_guilt merges into nothing_to_hide unless it reaches three uses by the end of chapter 2; police_need_proof_to_say_it, innocence_makes_talking_safe, rights_cover_only_me and guessing_is_harmless are single-use retags from chapter 1 and get the same call at the end of JUVENILE. The chapter 1 second pass added police_must_be_truthful and others_talking_voids_my_silence as single-use codes; both get the end-of-JUVENILE call like the earlier retag codes.

codes.silence_is_automatic: Going quiet counts as invoking the right to remain silent (Berghuis v. Thompkins says it does not).
codes.partial_answers_are_safe: Answering small questions but not big ones is a safe middle ground.
codes.my_side_helps: Explaining your side of the story clears things up.
codes.talking_earns_leniency: Cooperating and talking gets you a break.
codes.unclear_request_counts: An unsure request for a lawyer is enough (Davis v. United States says it may not be).
codes.no_money_no_lawyer: You only get a lawyer if you can pay for one.
codes.miranda_at_arrest: The Miranda warning is required the moment you are arrested.
codes.booking_needs_miranda: Routine booking questions count as interrogation.
codes.nothing_to_hide: Refusing a search implies you have something to hide. How a refusal looks in the moment, to the person in front of you.
codes.refusal_implies_guilt: Saying no can be used against you later as evidence of guilt. What a refusal can be used for afterward, not how it looks at the time.
codes.police_can_always_search: A request to search is really a command.
codes.partial_consent_is_safe: Agreeing to a limited look keeps the search limited.
codes.opening_it_yourself_is_different: Showing them yourself is not the same as consenting.
codes.everything_needs_a_warrant: Police always need a warrant; plain view does not exist.
codes.holding_phone_means_reading_it: Seizing a phone permits searching its contents (Riley v. California).
codes.roommate_can_consent_to_anything: Anyone living in the home can consent to searching your private space.
codes.nerves_are_suspicion: Being nervous is by itself a good enough reason to stop or search someone.
codes.police_can_hold_anyone: Police can detain anyone for any reason.
codes.must_always_give_name: You must always identify yourself on demand (Michigan differs).
codes.id_law_is_national: ID requirements are the same in every state.
codes.passenger_has_driver_duties: A passenger has the same obligations as the driver.
codes.frisk_opens_everything: A pat-down permits a full search.
codes.can_refuse_to_exit: You can decline an order to step out of the car (Mimms/Wilson).
codes.illegal_stop_means_resist: An unlawful stop can be physically resisted.
codes.violation_means_self_help: A rights violation can be stopped on the spot.
codes.being_right_helps_now: Arguing the law during the encounter works.
codes.must_open_the_door: A knock obligates you to open the door.
codes.talking_at_open_door_is_safe: Opening the door to talk is not consent to enter.
codes.stepping_outside_is_neutral: Stepping outside your home costs you nothing.
codes.school_matches_street: Schools need the same justification police need (they need less; New Jersey v. T.L.O.).
codes.sro_is_off_the_record: Talking to a school resource officer is casual and off the record.
codes.filming_needs_permission: You need permission to record police.
codes.must_be_on_own_property: You can only record from your own property.
codes.any_dispersal_order_is_lawful: Any order to stop or disperse is lawful.
codes.private_recording_is_always_ok: Keeping a recording private makes it legal.
codes.rumor_is_enough: A name passed along, with nothing behind it, is by itself a good enough reason to search you.
codes.group_suspicion_covers_everyone: Suspicion about a group lets staff search every person in it.
codes.search_has_no_limits: Once a search has started, whatever started it lets staff look anywhere, in anything.
codes.finding_something_makes_it_legal: Whatever turned up proves the search was allowed.
codes.school_owns_what_you_bring: Anything you carry onto school grounds is school property and can be searched at will.
codes.my_lock_makes_it_private: Your own lock, or a locker fee you paid, makes the locker yours.
codes.the_lot_is_off_campus: A car parked at school gets the same protection as a car parked on the street.
codes.passcode_must_be_given: When staff take your phone, you have to unlock it for them.
codes.deleting_it_ends_it: Deleting a photo or a message puts it out of reach.
codes.suspicionless_checks_need_a_reason: Dog sweeps, metal detectors, and team drug testing each need a reason aimed at you personally.
codes.saying_no_stops_it_at_school: Refusing consent stops a school search the way it can stop a police search.
codes.saying_nothing_is_agreeing: Letting a search happen without objecting counts as agreeing to it.
codes.school_findings_stay_at_school: What school staff find cannot reach police or a court case.
codes.bad_search_undoes_discipline: If the search was improper, the school punishment goes away too.
codes.police_need_proof_to_say_it: Police cannot claim to have a confession or evidence unless they really do.
codes.innocence_makes_talking_safe: If you did nothing wrong, talking cannot hurt you.
codes.rights_cover_only_me: The right to remain silent only covers questions about yourself.
codes.guessing_is_harmless: Giving your best guess is safe as long as you are trying to tell the truth.
codes.off_campus_ends_school_rules: Once you are off school grounds, school staff have no more say than any other adult.
codes.only_police_really_search: What school staff do is not really a search; only a police search counts.
codes.school_needs_no_reason: At school, staff can search whatever they want without needing a reason at all.
codes.police_must_be_truthful: Police are not allowed to lie to you while they question you.
codes.parent_decides_for_me: A parent can decide for you whether you talk to police.
codes.others_talking_voids_my_silence: Once somebody else tells the story, staying quiet no longer helps you.
codes.rights_start_at_charges: Your rights only start once you have actually been charged with something.
codes.a_violation_throws_it_out: If police break a rule, whatever comes after is automatically thrown out.
codes.rights_depend_on_a_signal: Your rights only apply once something official happens: a uniform, handcuffs, or being told.
codes.the_label_decides_the_rule: What an adult calls it, a look, a check, a quick chat, decides which rules apply.
codes.the_handbook_is_the_law: Whatever the student handbook says is what the school is allowed to do.
codes.one_track_replaces_the_other: School discipline and a court case cannot both run; one takes over from the other.
codes.a_yes_cannot_be_taken_back: Once you agree to a search you cannot stop it partway through.
